name: Entrepreneurship and Skill Development Programme
briefDescription: The Entrepreneurship and Skill Development Programme (ESDP) nurtures youth talent by enlightening them on industrial and business activities for setting up enterprises.
descriptionMd: The Entrepreneurship and Skill Development Programme (ESDP) is a central scheme launched under the 'Development of MSMEs' vertical by the O/o DC-MSME. It is organized regularly to nurture the talent of youth. The programme aims to enlighten young individuals on various aspects of industrial and business activity essential for establishing new ventures.
benefitsMd:
*   Enlightenment on various aspects of industrial activity.
*   Guidance and knowledge on business activities.
*   Support and preparation for setting up new enterprises.
eligibilityMd:
*   Applicants must be identified as 'youth'.
*   Individuals interested in learning about industrial and business activities.
*   Those aspiring to set up new enterprises or businesses.
applicationMd: Contact the nodal department or visit the official scheme portal to apply.
